title: Wall Runner
shortDescription: A polished 2D mobile game with multiple balls, power-ups, and leveled/endless modes — LIVE on PlayStore.
description: A complete mobile game built in Unity where walls fall from the top while the player swipes their ball character to avoid them. Features multiple unlockable balls, varied movement types, power-up system, and both level-based and endless game modes. Currently in open testing on the PlayStore.
